name: skyscraper
description: Scan existing solutions before you build from scratch. Given a marketing problem, Skyscraper fans out parallel scouts across native Claude skills, the Apify Store, Reddit, and YouTube, then returns a ranked report of what already exists and how to clone or adapt it. Run it whenever you're about to vibe-code a custom tool. Includes the skyscraper-setup command to show which optional API keys are active.
